title: 第21章 篝火凝柔意 灵玉赠佳人第22章 沧霄巡天地 残身向南奔
lines: 夜阑渐深，庇护所之内幽暗清冷。罗止正抬手拾来干柴，于屋内角落引燃篝火，跳动的橘色火苗缓缓升腾，暖黄火光漫开，驱散了庇护所深处的阴冷，将周遭昏暗尽数照亮。晚风顺着木缝轻穿而入，携来林间微凉的草木气息，白日鏖战耗损的气血尚未平复，两人身上的爪伤依旧隐隐作痛，周身灵气尚且滞涩紊乱。
李紫云静坐于干草之上，抬手从腰间储物袋中取出两株碧叶灵心草。叶片通体碧绿鲜亮、修长饱满，散发着淡淡清新草木清香。可快速愈合皮肉伤势，稳定体内紊乱灵气，缓解身心疲惫；服用后能舒缓伤痛、加速伤口愈合。
李紫云将其中一株碧叶灵心草递向身旁的罗止正，他伸手接过，二人并肩静坐，无需多余言语，同时抬手将手中碧叶灵心草送入口中。灵草入口即化，清甜微凉的药力顺着喉间淌入经脉，缓缓游走周身四肢百骸。原本撕裂渗血的皮肉伤口痛感飞速消减，激战过后紊乱的灵气渐渐归位平复，一身紧绷的疲惫也随之慢慢消散。
两人皆闭目凝神，静坐调息，任由草木灵韵缓缓滋养伤势、抚平气血暗耗。篝火火苗轻轻跃动，暖光笼罩二人周身，简陋的庇护所内寂静安然，只余两人平稳绵长的呼吸，与周身缓缓流转的柔和灵息。
待二人调息疗伤完毕，体内药力尽数化开，伤口痛感已然消散大半，周身紊乱灵气尽数归稳。
随后，罗止正缓缓睁开眼起身，迈步走向庇护所门侧角落，弯腰将此前安置在那的金斑岩獾尸体稳稳抱起，走到篝火旁的空地上放下。他自腰间抽出随身骨刀，刀刃寒光微闪，借着篝火跃动的暖光，指尖娴熟地顺着灵兽皮毛肌理下刀。
骨刀游走利落又轻柔，避开筋骨要害，不过片刻，便将整张带着暖金色斑纹的岩獾兽皮完整剥离，皮毛平整无破损，厚实又坚韧。剥完兽皮，他目光微沉，持刀精准剖开异兽躯体，细心从中抽出一截柔韧莹亮的兽筋，这兽筋韧性十足，是缝制兽皮、加固器物的上好材料，他随手将兽筋放在一旁，留着后续合用。
处理完兽筋，他才抬手分割獾身灵肉，将鲜嫩的灵肉切成大小均匀的肉块，折来几根粗细适中的坚韧树枝，将肉块一一串起，小心架在篝火上方的空位，用文火慢慢烘烤。
油脂顺着肉块纹路缓缓渗出，滴落在篝火中溅起细碎火星，浓郁的肉香混着草木气息，在庇护所内慢慢散开，勾得人食欲微动。
余下的新鲜灵肉，罗止正用干净藤条轻轻捆好，抬手递到身旁李紫云面前。
李紫云抬眸看了看，伸手接过捆扎整齐的灵肉，将其尽数收进储物袋中储存，留着日后食用。
做完这一切，她望着罗止正手中那张完整粗韧的兽皮，眉眼微动，心头满是好奇，语气轻软道：“你留着这整张兽皮，打算用来做什么？”
罗止正指尖轻抚过厚实坚韧的兽皮，抬眸看向李紫云，眼底漾着浅浅笑意，语气温和又认真道：“先前给你缝制的青纹兽皮毯太过窄小，我打算把这张灵獾兽皮加进去拼接扩充，把毯子改得宽大一些，往后夜里歇息，我们两人一同盖着也足够暖和。”
这话入耳，李紫云脸颊瞬间涌上一层淡粉，从脸颊蔓延至耳尖，眼睫猛地一颤，下意识抬眼瞪了他一眼，眸底含着几分羞恼，又藏着一丝不易察觉的慌乱，抿了抿唇，语气娇嗔道：“想得美，谁要跟你同盖一张毯子呀。”
她说完，连忙别开视线，看向跳动的篝火，耳尖的红晕久久不散，指尖轻轻攥着衣角，心底却泛起一丝淡淡的暖意，连带着周身的空气都变得温热起来。
罗止正看着她羞涩躲闪的模样，唇角笑意微深，也不拆穿，只是低头默默整理着手中的兽皮与兽筋，篝火噼啪作响，肉香愈发浓郁。
话虽这么说，她却还是默默转过身，抬手探入腰间储物袋，指尖一番翻找，将那张叠得整整齐齐的青纹兽皮毯取了出来，略显别扭地往前递了递，直接塞到罗止正手上，耳根的红晕愈发浓重，却刻意偏过头不看他，语气带着几分逞强道：“给你，要改便改，别到时候说我小气。”
罗止正看着手中轻薄柔软的青纹兽皮毯，眼底笑意愈浓，也不戳破她口是心非的心思，语气沉稳道：“好。”
篝火噼啪作响，烤肉的香气愈发浓郁，油脂被烤得滋滋作响，表面泛着诱人的金黄光泽，显然已经烤制得恰到好处。
李紫云闻着鼻尖醇厚的肉香，率先伸手拿起一串烤肉，小口咬下一块。灵肉肉质鲜嫩，入口鲜香，毫无腥膻之气，汁水在舌尖化开，她眉眼微微舒展，语气轻快道：“这肉烤得真好吃。”
说着，她又拿起另一串还带着温热的烤肉，顺手递到罗止正面前，眼底带着几分真切的关切，语气温柔道：“你也快吃吧，奔波了一天，肯定很饿了吧。”
罗止正指尖依旧捏着骨针，沉稳地将最后几针缝完，仔细把两张兽皮的衔接处收线收尾，一张宽大厚实的拼接兽皮毯便彻底完工。他这才放下骨针，伸手接过李紫云递来的肉串，大口吃了起来。一日激战与奔波的疲惫，仿佛都在这鲜香的灵肉中慢慢消解。
两人安静地吃完烤肉，罗止正抬手擦了擦唇角，随即从腰间掏出银月水囊，指尖灵活拧开囊塞，径直递到李紫云面前，语气温柔关切道：“喝点水吧，刚吃完烤肉肯定很口渴了。”
李紫云抬手接过水囊，凑到唇边浅浅喝了几口，清冽甘爽的清水润过喉咙，消解了口中的油腻干渴。她随即把水囊递回给罗止正，语气轻柔道：“你也喝一点吧。”
罗止正接过水囊，仰头饮了几口，随后便重新拧紧囊塞，稳妥地将银月水囊放回腰间。
夜色渐深，山林晚风裹挟着淡淡凉意，一日的赶路、厮杀疗伤早已耗尽心神，没过多久，浓重的困意便席卷了李紫云。她轻揉眉眼，起身走到干草铺旁躺下，很快便沉沉酣睡，呼吸变得平稳绵长。
罗止正目光温柔地落在她熟睡的容颜上，起身拿起方才缝制好的拼接兽皮毯，缓步走到草铺边，轻轻将毯子盖在李紫云身上，细心掖好边角，隔绝夜里山林的寒气。
熟睡中的李紫云似是察觉到身上传来的暖意，下意识抬手轻轻抚摸着柔软厚实的兽皮毯，眉眼舒展，睡得愈发安稳沉静。
篝火余火轻轻跃动，暖光漫满整座庇护所，屋外虫鸣低吟，屋内静谧安然。
罗止正静静伫立片刻，望着草铺上酣睡安稳的李紫云，确认她周身暖意充足，不再受夜寒侵扰。随后他轻手轻脚退到篝火旁，动作放得极缓，生怕惊扰了熟睡的少女。
接着，他自腰间取出一枚拇指大小的碧翠灵玉，玉珠通体澄澈莹绿，玉质温润细腻，内里萦绕着淡淡的青绿流光，表面光洁纯净无一丝杂色，触手微凉，隐隐裹挟着清和内敛的灵气。
借着跳动的火光，他取出随身骨刀，以刀刃细钝的一侧细细打磨玉珠周身，将原本细微的粗糙纹路尽数磨平，让整颗圆珠愈发圆润光滑，光泽更加莹润透亮。
打磨完毕，他握着骨刀尖锐的顶端，沉稳发力，小心翼翼地在玉珠顶端钻出一个细小规整的穿孔，力道拿捏精准，顺利打通玉孔，却丝毫没有崩裂、损伤灵玉本身。
随后，他取来此前处理岩獾时留存的柔韧兽筋，抽出一缕纤细坚韧的筋线，仔细穿过玉珠顶端的孔洞，反复缠绕打结、收紧固定，编结成一条简约结实的颈链。
素净兽筋搭配莹绿玉珠，质朴又温润。他将做好的灵玉项链轻轻握在掌心，指尖轻触微凉玉面，望着掌心这条灵韵流转的颈链，眸光柔和，心底默默为其定名。此玉澄澈碧翠，灵气绵长，以后便叫碧翠灵玉链吧，既贴合灵玉本身质地，又藏着温润守护之意，只待寻个合适时机，赠予眼前少女，护她往后行路平安，远离凶险。
他指尖轻轻摩挲着碧翠灵玉链，将其小心翼翼收进腰间，而后便倚靠着庇护所内木墙静静守望着熟睡的李紫云。
content_en:
The night was getting darker, and the shelter was dark and cold. Luo Zhi was raising his hands to collect dry firewood and lit a bonfire in the corner of the house. The dancing orange flames rose slowly and the warm yellow light spread, dispelling the coldness deep in the shelter and illuminating the darkness around him. The evening breeze gently penetrated through the cracks in the wood, bringing with it the cool scent of vegetation in the forest. The energy and blood drained by the fierce battle during the day had not yet recovered. The claw wounds on the two people's bodies were still aching, and the spiritual energy around their bodies was still stagnant and disordered.
Li Ziyun sat quietly on the hay, raised his hand and took out two Biye Lingxin grass from the storage bag on his waist. The leaves are green and bright, slender and full, exuding a light and fresh grassy fragrance. It can quickly heal skin and flesh injuries, stabilize disordered spiritual energy in the body, and relieve physical and mental fatigue; it can relieve pain and accelerate wound healing after taking it.
Li Ziyun handed one of the Blue-leaf Lingxincao to Luo Zhizheng beside him. He reached out to take it. The two sat side by side in silence without any need for words. At the same time, he raised his hand and put the Blue-leaf Lingxincao into his mouth. The spiritual grass melts in the mouth, and the sweet and slightly cool medicinal power flows down the throat into the meridians, and slowly travels throughout the body, limbs and bones. The pain in the originally torn and bleeding flesh wound quickly subsided. After the fierce battle, the chaotic spiritual energy gradually returned to its normal state, and the tight fatigue slowly dissipated.
Both of them closed their eyes and concentrated, sat quietly and adjusted their breath, allowing the aura of the vegetation to slowly nourish their injuries and smooth out the depletion of energy and blood. The flames of the bonfire danced gently, and the warm light enveloped the two people. The simple shelter was quiet and peaceful, except for the steady and long breathing of the two people and the soft spiritual breath flowing slowly around them.
After the two men finished adjusting their breath to heal their wounds, all the medicine in their bodies had been released, most of the pain in the wounds had dissipated, and all the disordered aura around the body had stabilized.
Then, Luo Zhizheng slowly opened his eyes and stood up, walked towards the corner beside the door of the shelter, bent down and picked up the body of the golden porphyry badger that had been placed there before, and walked to the open space next to the bonfire to put it down. He took out the bone knife from his waist, the blade shimmering with cold light, and under the warm light of the bonfire, his fingertips skillfully followed the texture of the spirit animal's fur.
The bone knife moved neatly and gently, avoiding the vital points of the muscles and bones. In just a moment, the entire rock badger hide with warm golden markings was completely peeled off. The fur was smooth and undamaged, thick and tough. After peeling off the animal's skin, his eyes darkened, and he accurately cut open the body of the alien beast with a knife, carefully extracting a section of pliable and shiny animal sinew. This animal sinew was very tough and was a good material for sewing animal skins and reinforcing utensils. He casually put the animal tendon aside for future use.
After processing the animal tendons, he raised his hand to cut the badger's spiritual flesh. He cut the tender spiritual meat into evenly sized meat pieces, folded a few tough branches of moderate thickness, strung the meat pieces together one by one, carefully placed them in the empty space above the campfire, and roasted them slowly over a slow fire.
The grease slowly seeped out along the lines of the meat, dripping into the campfire and splashing tiny sparks. The rich aroma of meat mixed with the scent of vegetation slowly spread in the shelter, making people's appetites twitch.
Luo Zhizheng gently tied the remaining fresh spiritual flesh with clean rattan sticks and handed it to Li Ziyun beside him.
Li Ziyun raised his eyes and looked at it, then reached out to take the neatly tied spiritual meat and put it all into the storage bag for later consumption.
After doing all this, she looked at the intact and thick animal skin in Luo Zhizheng's hand, her eyebrows moved slightly, her heart was full of curiosity, and she said in a soft tone: "What do you plan to use this whole animal skin for?"
Luo Zhizheng's fingertips gently stroked the thick and tough animal skin, and he raised his eyes to look at Li Ziyun. There was a slight smile in his eyes, and he said in a gentle and serious tone: "The blue-striped animal skin blanket I made for you earlier was too narrow. I plan to add this spirit badger skin to the splicing and expand it to make the blanket wider. When we rest at night, it will be warm enough for the two of us to cover it together."
When these words were heard, Li Ziyun's cheeks instantly turned pale pink, spreading from his cheeks to the tips of his ears. His eyelashes trembled suddenly, and he subconsciously raised his eyes to glare at him. There was a bit of embarrassment in his eyes, but there was also a trace of unnoticeable panic. He pursed his lips and said in a coquettish tone: "It's a beautiful idea, who wants to share a blanket with you?"
After she finished speaking, she quickly looked away and looked at the beating bonfire. The blush on the tips of her ears lingered for a long time. Her fingertips gently grasped the corners of her clothes, but there was a faint warmth in her heart, and the air around her became warmer.
Luo Zhi was looking at her shy and evasive look, with a deep smile on his lips. He didn't show it off, he just lowered his head and silently arranged the animal skins and tendons in his hands. The campfire crackled and the smell of meat became stronger.
Having said that, she turned around silently, raised her hand to reach into the storage bag at her waist, rummaged with her fingertips, and took out the neatly folded blue-patterned animal skin blanket. She handed it forward slightly awkwardly and put it directly into Luo Zhi's hand. The blush on her ears became more intense, but she deliberately turned her head away from him and said in a somewhat assertive tone: "Here it is, change it if you want. Don't call me stingy then."
Luo Zhi was looking at the thin and soft blue-patterned animal skin blanket in his hand. The smile in his eyes grew stronger. Without revealing her duplicity, he said in a calm tone: "Okay."
The campfire crackled, the aroma of barbecue became more intense, the fat was roasted sizzling, and the surface had an attractive golden sheen, obviously it had been roasted to perfection.
Li Ziyun smelled the mellow aroma of meat on the tip of his nose, took the lead in reaching out and picked up a skewer of barbecue, and took a small bite of a piece. The meat is tender and fragrant in the mouth, without any fishy smell. The juice melts on the tip of the tongue. She relaxed her eyebrows slightly and said in a brisk tone: "This meat is so delicious when grilled."
As she said that, she picked up another skewer of warm barbecue and handed it to Luo Zhizheng. With some real concern in her eyes, she said in a gentle tone: "You should eat quickly. You must be very hungry after running around all day."
Luo Zhizheng still held the bone needle with his fingertips, and calmly finished the last few stitches, carefully closing the threads at the junction of the two animal skins, and a large and thick spliced ​​animal skin blanket was completely completed. Only then did he put down the bone needle, reached out to take the meat skewers from Li Ziyun, and started eating. The fatigue from a day of fierce fighting and running around seemed to be slowly dissipated in this fragrant spiritual flesh.
The two of them finished the barbecue quietly. Luo Zhizheng raised his hand to wipe the corner of his lips, then took out the silver moon water bag from his waist. He unscrewed the plug of the bag with his fingertips and handed it directly to Li Ziyun. He said in a gentle and concerned tone: "Drink some water. I must be very thirsty just after eating the barbecue."
Li Ziyun raised his hand to take the water bag, brought it to his lips and took a few sips. The refreshing and refreshing water moistened his throat, quenching the greasy thirst in his mouth. She immediately handed the water bag back to Luo Zhizheng and said softly, "You can drink some too."
Luo Zhizheng took the water bag, raised his head and took a few sips, then re-tightened the stopper and put the silver moon water bag safely back to his waist.
The night was getting darker, and the evening breeze in the mountains and forests carried a slight coolness. The day's rush, fighting and healing had already exhausted his mind. It didn't take long for Li Ziyun to feel heavy sleepiness. She rubbed her brows gently, stood up, walked to the hay bunk and lay down. She soon fell into a deep sleep, and her breathing became steady and long.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes fell gently on her sleeping face. He stood up and picked up the patchwork animal skin blanket he had just sewn. He walked slowly to the edge of the grass bunk and gently covered Li Ziyun with the blanket, carefully tucking the corners to isolate the cold air of the forest at night.
Li Ziyun, who was sleeping soundly, seemed to be aware of the warmth coming from his body. He subconsciously raised his hand and gently stroked the soft and thick animal skin blanket. His eyebrows relaxed and he slept more peacefully.
The remnants of the bonfire danced gently, and the warm light filled the entire shelter. The insects chirped and hummed outside, and the house was quiet and peaceful.
Luo Zhizheng stood quietly for a moment, looking at Li Ziyun who was sleeping soundly on the grass bed, confirming that her whole body was warm enough and she was no longer disturbed by the cold night. Then he quietly retreated to the campfire, moving very slowly for fear of disturbing the sleeping girl.
Then, he took out a thumb-sized emerald jade from his waist. The jade bead was completely clear and translucent green, with a warm and delicate texture. There was a faint green light lingering inside. The surface was smooth and pure without any trace of color. The tentacles were slightly cool, faintly carrying a gentle and restrained aura.
By the dancing light of the fire, he took out his bone knife and carefully polished the whole body of the jade bead with the blunt side of the blade, smoothing out all the original fine rough lines, making the whole bead rounder and smoother, and its luster more translucent.
After polishing, he held the sharp tip of the bone knife, exerted force calmly, and carefully drilled a small and regular hole in the top of the jade bead. With precise force, he successfully opened the jade hole without cracking or damaging the jade itself.
Then, he took the pliable animal tendons that he had saved from the previous treatment of rock badgers, pulled out a wisp of slender and tough tendons, carefully passed them through the holes at the top of the jade beads, repeatedly twisted and knotted them, tightened and fixed them, and knitted them into a simple and strong necklace.
The pure animal sinews are paired with green jade beads, which are simple and warm. He gently held the finished spiritual jade necklace in his palm, touched the cool jade surface lightly with his fingertips, and looked at the necklace with flowing charm in his palm. His eyes were soft and he silently named it in his heart. This jade is clear and green, with long spiritual energy. From now on, it will be called the green jade chain. It not only matches the texture of the jade itself, but also contains a gentle and protective meaning. I just need to find a suitable opportunity to give it to the girl in front of me to protect her from danger in the future.
He gently rubbed the jade chain with his fingertips, carefully put it into his waist, and then leaned against the wooden wall of the shelter to quietly watch the sleeping Li Ziyun.
title_en: Chapter 21 The bonfire condenses the tenderness, the spiritual jade is given to the beautiful woman, Chapter 22 The sky patrols the world, and the body runs south
